passages.quote:
This guide includes recommendations on 5 building blocks to improving social mobility in the workplace:

Vision – create a compelling, shared vision of socio-economic diversity and inclusion across your business.

Talent – widen your talent pool.

Culture – create a diverse and inclusive culture.

Progression – make sure the best can succeed.

Key question – ask the key question and analyse your data.
